verdict.text: Both blocking findings are fixed, and I found nothing the fixes broke.
The repository root without .okf/ is now refused with a message that names a folder to give.
The legacy store copy now goes to a unique temp file and is linked into place with os.link, which fails rather than overwrites when the store already exists.
f3 and f4 are fixed too.
Pass.
`loopctl gate stamp` from the worktree: lint, format, tests and integration pass, and rows r1 to r9 pass.
"stamp green: 14a08a0fbcfd62ea2e4642626743c2ded8c8f63133ee350ef4b64e9789bd1baf".
f1: read resolve_target and namespaces.repository_root.

In a scratch git repo with docs/, handbook/ and README.md and no .okf/, `kmaudit claims todo` exits 1 with "is the repository root, which holds no .okf/; give the folder ... such as docs", and creates no .kmaudit/.
After that, `claims todo docs` gives namespace docs, and running `claims todo` with no argument from inside docs/ also gives docs.
Outside git, a folder gets its own namespace, with the folder's parent as the root.
The root can only equal the path inside a git repo, so the refusal cannot trigger by mistake outside one.
Nothing references _git_root any more.
The new test asserts exit 1, the hint, empty stdout, no '..sqlite' store, and that a later `todo docs` succeeds.
f2: read store._copy and its caller in Store.__init__.
A unique mkstemp file sits in the same folder, so os.link stays on one filesystem.
FileExistsError means another process won, and the temp file is always unlinked.
I ran 8 parallel `kmaudit claims list .okf` processes over a copy of the operator's real legacy store, 5 times.
Every process exited 0 every time, no .partial file was left, integrity_check gave ok, the claims count was 1281, and the legacy file's md5 did not change.
The new test starts 6 processes and asserts they all succeed, no .partial file is left, and the claims are kept.
f3: `-k maps` now also collects test_a_folder_holding_a_namespace_maps_to_a_refusal_naming_it.
f4: r1's test compares the full set of section ids, with a count guard of 5.
f1 resolved: sections.py:142-148 refuses the root when it holds no .okf/.
namespaces.repository_root is the one root rule.
f2 resolved: store.py:158-184 writes to a unique temp file and publishes with os.link, which never overwrites.
f3 resolved: r2b's selection now includes the refusal test.
f4 resolved: test_namespaces.py:109 asserts every section id.
The concurrency test calls wait() before it reads the pipes.
If a process's stdout ever grew past the pipe buffer (64 KB), the test could deadlock.
Today's output is small.
communicate() would remove the risk.
